baseline: v141 exact decoder PASS, Voynich surface NO-GO; v138 original global injectivity NO-GO

hypotheses.H1: One printed ciphertext token per normalized plaintext word; in-word markers and state-conditional prefix-free cells recover exact source and boundaries without per-message side information.
hypotheses.H2: Output passes strict glyph/atom seam admissibility against author's B-reference inventory without modification to fit the generated output.
hypotheses.H3: Historical VBM identifiable against an unconstrained autonomous slot generator using manuscript surface observables alone. This is declared nonidentifiable without independent anchor, and NOT tested.

test_order: check input hashes and existing falsifications
prove prefix-free capacity and present grammar
build from Bavarian only and freeze
hard negatives including collisions and tampered markers
surface gate against fixed B inventory; halt if fails
leakage_rules: Source unit ordering may use only Bavarian development counts. Existing B inventory is imported as historically fitted and therefore any compatibility is in-sample; use only as a necessary feasibility gate, never as independent corroboration.
explicitly_relaxed_from_v141: Vowels now have dedicated internal single-glyph values, not the original next-key-dependent VBM pair table. This is a constructive engineering control, not the same VBM hypothesis.
not_permitted: No word dictionary expansion, no post-hoc seam repairs, no exceptions for heldout failures, no global manuscript claim, no use of holdout to fit codebook, no VMS section pooling for inference.
positive_control: Exact decode of text encoded by grammar from separate source; arbitrary new combinations of existing alphabet.
hard_negatives: duplicate codeword in one state must fail
marker collision with cell key must fail
word-space removal must not be interpreted as original plaintext
mechanism_identification: Not admissible without independently verified plaintext/linguistic anchor or a frozen prediction that hard matched autonomous controls cannot reproduce.
